title: Daily Devotional #33
paragraphs: As I read Mark 5 today, I am struck by the many miracles that Jesus performed. The chapter starts with the story of the demon-possessed man, who was living among the tombs and was tormented by evil spirits. Jesus freed him from the demons, and the man was able to return to his family and community.

Next, we read about the healing of the woman with the issue of blood. She had been suffering for 12 years and had spent all her money on doctors, but none of them could heal her. However, when she touched Jesus' garment, she was immediately healed.

Finally, we read about the healing of Jairus' daughter. Jairus, a synagogue leader, begged Jesus to come and heal his daughter, who was dying. Despite the ridicule of the mourners who believed the girl was already dead, Jesus took her by the hand and brought her back to life.

Lord, as I reflect on these stories, I am reminded of your power and your compassion. You have the power to heal and to free us from the things that torment us. You care about our suffering and want to bring us back to life.

Help me to have faith like the demon-possessed man, who recognized Jesus' authority and begged to be healed. Help me to have faith like the woman with the issue of blood, who believed that just touching Jesus' garment would bring healing. Help me to have faith like Jairus, who trusted that Jesus could bring his daughter back to life.
Lord, I know that you are still in the business of performing miracles today. Help me to recognize your power and your presence in my life, and to trust you with all my heart.
